description: Developer upgraded SDK from 2.8 to 3.1. All API requests now return AUTH_401. They previously used 'Authorization: ApiKey <key>'. They are on SDK 3.1.

incident.description: AUTH_401 on all API requests after upgrading from SDK 2.8 to SDK 3.1. We were sending 'Authorization: ApiKey' but now every request fails.

notes: AUTH-001 and AUTH-005 are highly relevant but for SDK 2.x and must be excluded. AUTH-002 is the correct doc.

description: Developer gets HTTP 403 AUTH_403 on write operations. They have valid credentials but wrong scope.

incident.description: Getting AUTH_403 Forbidden when trying to create events via the API. Authentication works fine but the write endpoint rejects the request.

notes: AUTH-003 covers AUTH_403 for all versions. Clean straightforward case.

description: Developer is hitting rate limits. Simple case with clear error code.

incident.description: Our integration keeps getting RATE_429 errors during batch processing jobs. How do we handle rate limiting?

notes: Clear rate limit case. RATE-001 gives the fix, RATE-002 covers monitoring.

description: SDK 2.x developer: API key configuration. Simple setup question.

incident.description: How do I configure my API key in DevCore SDK? We're on version 2.5.

notes: SDK-003 is the 3.x config doc and must not be used for 2.5.

description: SDK 3.x developer: OAuth client secret rotation caused AUTH_401.

incident.description: We rotated our OAuth client secret in the dashboard and now all API calls are failing with AUTH_401. We're on SDK 3.0.

notes: TS-004 directly covers secret rotation AUTH_401 on SDK 3.x.

description: Webhook delivery failure due to slow endpoint response. Simple timing issue.

incident.description: DevCore is showing webhook delivery failures. Our endpoint is receiving the request but taking about 8 seconds to respond. We're on SDK 2.x version 2.9.

notes: SDK 2.x has 5s timeout, 8s response causes failure. WEBHOOK-002 is SDK 3.x doc (wrong version trap).

description: Developer gets VALIDATION_ERR. Clear client-side field validation issue.

incident.description: Getting VALIDATION_ERR 422 when calling the events endpoint. The error details mention a missing required field.

notes: ERR-001 covers VALIDATION_ERR for all versions. Straightforward.

description: SDK 3.x initialization fails due to missing environment variables.

incident.description: Our application fails to start with a ConfigurationError about missing DEVCORE_CLIENT_ID. We're deploying on SDK 3.2 in a Docker container.

notes: SDK-002 is the 2.x config reference and should not be used for 3.2.

description: Full 2.x to 3.x migration: auth change + webhook signature change + pagination change. Requires multiple docs.

incident.description: We're migrating from SDK 2.8 to SDK 3.1. After migration, we're getting AUTH_401, our webhooks are failing, and our pagination code breaks. What do we need to fix?

notes: Multi-doc migration case. Requires combining migration guide with specific fix docs. Wrong-version docs must be excluded.

description: Intermittent AUTH_401 in multi-threaded SDK 3.x app with token expiry race condition.

incident.description: We're getting intermittent AUTH_401 errors under high load on SDK 3.0. The errors are sporadic and seem to happen more when we have many concurrent requests. We've confirmed credentials are correct.

notes: Requires TS-001 for race condition and AUTH-004 for token expiry context.

description: Persistent 429 errors in multi-instance deployment sharing credentials.

incident.description: We scaled our service to 20 instances and now we're constantly hitting RATE_429 even though each instance should be well below the limit. We're on SDK 3.1.

notes: TS-005 covers shared credentials rate limiting. Combines with RATE-001 and RATE-002 for complete picture.

description: Webhook failures with multiple possible causes: endpoint response time + signature algorithm.

incident.description: Webhooks stopped working after upgrading to SDK 3.0. The dashboard shows delivery failures. We're not sure if it's our endpoint validation or a timeout issue.

notes: Multiple webhook docs needed. WEBHOOK-001 is wrong version (2.x).

description: Proxy environment with AUTH_401: could be proxy stripping auth headers + wrong auth format.

incident.description: Our SDK 3.1 application behind a corporate proxy is getting AUTH_401. We've confirmed the credentials are correct in a direct connection environment.

notes: Proxy may strip Bearer auth header. Needs CFG-002 (proxy config) + AUTH-002 (3.x auth format).

description: Performance issue: high latency + rate limit errors from tight polling loop.

incident.description: Our integration has high latency and keeps getting RATE_429. We're polling the events API every second to check for updates on SDK 3.1.

notes: Requires understanding that polling is the antipattern (PERF-001 mentions webhooks as alternative) plus rate limit fix.

description: ERR_TIMEOUT on specific endpoints + general debugging guidance.

incident.description: Our exports API calls keep timing out with ERR_TIMEOUT on SDK 2.8. Normal API calls work fine.

notes: API-001 covers ERR_TIMEOUT with export API guidance. SDK-004 is version-agnostic debug checklist.

description: Full security concern: credential leak + webhook validation + environment best practices.

incident.description: We suspect our SDK 3.x OAuth credentials may have been exposed in a Git commit. What should we do and how do we secure our integration going forward?

notes: Security best practices multi-doc case. SECURITY-001 is general. TS-004 covers rotating secrets. CFG-001 covers proper env var setup.

description: AUTH_401 on SDK 3.1 — highly relevant 2.x doc exists as a trap.

incident.description: Getting AUTH_401 after moving from SDK 2.8 to 3.1. I've confirmed the API key is valid.

notes: Classic version-conflict trap. AUTH-001 is highly relevant for AUTH_401 but wrong version. AUTH-002 is correct. AUTH-005 is also 2.x trap.

description: Webhook failures on SDK 3.0 — SDK 2.x webhook doc is highly relevant trap.

incident.description: Our webhook endpoint is rejecting DevCore deliveries. We're on SDK 3.0.

notes: WEBHOOK-001 covers the same symptom but for SDK 2.x. Must use WEBHOOK-002 for 3.x.

description: Pagination broken on SDK 3.x — offset/limit 2.x pagination doc is a trap.

incident.description: Our pagination code stopped working after upgrading to SDK 3.1. We're using offset and limit query parameters.

notes: API-002 is the 2.x pagination doc. API-003 explains cursor-based pagination for 3.x.

description: SDK configuration wrong: used DEVCORE_API_KEY env var on SDK 3.x.

incident.description: We set DEVCORE_API_KEY environment variable but our SDK 3.2 application is still failing to authenticate with AUTH_401.

notes: CFG-001 explicitly states DEVCORE_API_KEY is ignored in SDK 3.x. SDK-002 and AUTH-005 are 2.x traps.

description: Timestamp parsing broken on SDK 3.x — SDK 2.x timestamp behavior is the trap.

incident.description: After upgrading to SDK 3.1 from 2.9, our code that reads created_at timestamps from API responses raises ValueError: invalid literal for int().

notes: API-004 covers the SDK 3.x timestamp format change. API-002 is an incidental 2.x trap.

description: AUTH_403 vs AUTH_401 — developer confused about which error they have.

incident.description: Our API calls are failing with a 403 status code. We think we might have an authentication problem.

notes: The incident says 403 (AUTH_403) but naively the system might retrieve AUTH_401 docs too. Must correctly distinguish scope vs credential issues.

description: NOT_FOUND 404 vs AUTH_403 — resource access failure ambiguity.

incident.description: We're getting 404 errors when accessing resources that we believe exist. We have valid credentials.

notes: DevCore returns 404 for permission-hidden resources. ERR-003 explains this. AUTH-003 covers 403 (different code).

description: RATE_429 vs ERR_TIMEOUT — high-latency timeout confusion.

incident.description: Our API calls are very slow and sometimes never return. We're seeing ERR_TIMEOUT errors.

notes: ERR_TIMEOUT is a different issue from RATE_429. The system must not conflate slow responses with rate limits.

description: Webhook signature failure confused with webhook delivery timing failure.

incident.description: Our webhook endpoint is returning 401 to DevCore. We're not sure if it's a signature problem or something else. We're on SDK 3.1.

notes: TS-002 covers signature validation failures (algorithm mismatch). WEBHOOK-002 covers the 3.x delivery failure context.

description: Developer asks about SDK 4.x features — corpus only covers up to 3.x.

incident.description: We're upgrading to DevCore SDK 4.0. What authentication changes do we need to make from 3.x?

notes: Corpus covers up to SDK 3.x only. No applicable docs for SDK 4.0. System should abstain.

description: General webhook question — corpus covers symptoms and fixes but not a general architecture explanation.

incident.description: Can you explain how DevCore webhooks work architecturally? We want to understand the delivery guarantees and retry semantics at a high level.

notes: WEBHOOK-003 gives some information but it's troubleshooting-focused, not an architectural overview. Partial answer at best.

description: Bulk operations question — general answer available but not for the specific 3.x batch format details.

incident.description: We want to create thousands of events as fast as possible on SDK 3.1. What's the most efficient approach?

notes: PERF-002 mentions the v3/batch endpoint but lacks detailed usage examples. PERF-001 adds context. Near miss — enough to give partial guidance.

description: Developer asks about SLAs and uptime guarantees — not covered in corpus.

incident.description: What is the DevCore API uptime SLA? We need this for our service contract review.

notes: Corpus has no SLA documentation. The system should recognize it cannot answer this.

description: Completely unsupported: DevCore billing and pricing questions.

incident.description: How much does the DevCore Enterprise tier cost? We need to compare it with our current plan.

notes: No billing or pricing documentation in corpus. Must abstain.

description: Completely unsupported: asking about a competitor product's integration.

incident.description: How do I integrate DevCore with third-party product 'AcmeMQ' for event streaming? We need message queue integration.

notes: Third-party integration docs not in corpus. Corpus covers DevCore itself. Must abstain.

description: AUTH_401 with no version — applicable evidence spans both 2.x and 3.x, cannot be resolved.

incident.description: I'm getting AUTH_401 on my API calls. How do I fix it?

notes: AUTH_401 has fundamentally different causes and fixes in SDK 2.x vs 3.x. Without version, applicability cannot be determined. NEEDS_INFO.

description: Vague description with no error code and no version.

incident.description: Something is wrong with our API integration. Requests aren't working.

notes: Description lacks any actionable technical signal. Cannot form a meaningful retrieval query.

description: Webhook failure with no version — signature algorithm differs between 2.x and 3.x.

incident.description: Our webhooks are failing. The dashboard shows delivery errors but I don't know why.

notes: Webhook failures have different root causes in 2.x (SHA1) vs 3.x (SHA256). Version needed to select applicable doc.

description: Authentication token behavior — two applicable docs describe different token TTLs.

incident.description: How long does a DevCore Bearer token last in SDK 3.1? We need to configure our refresh interval correctly.

notes: AUTH-004 says tokens expire after 3600 seconds. AUTH-002 mentions token expiry but is less specific about the exact TTL. Slight inconsistency in precision, but not fundamental contradiction. Partial answer on specifics.

description: Webhook timeout value — different applicable docs state different timeouts for SDK 3.x.

incident.description: What is the webhook delivery timeout for SDK 3.0? We need to make sure our endpoint responds in time.

notes: WEBHOOK-003 and WEBHOOK-002 both state 10s for SDK 3.x. Consistent, so FULL answer possible. Designed as a near-contradiction test (both docs cover it).

description: Rate limit values — docs mention different tier limits, ambiguous which tier applies.

incident.description: What is our rate limit? We are getting RATE_429 and need to know the exact limit so we can configure our retry logic on SDK 3.1.

notes: RATE-001 gives multiple tier values (100/min, 1000/min) but does not know which tier the client is on. Partial answer — can explain how to check but cannot give exact value.
